# 1 Clement Chapter 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 10 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 10

**10:1** Abraham was called "God's Friend" — and he earned that title by faithfully obeying God's word.

**10:2** He set out from his homeland, his relatives, and his father's household — a small piece of land, a small group of people, a modest home — and left it all behind to inherit God's promises. For God had said to him: [Gen 12:1]

**10:3** "Leave your land, your relatives, and your father's household and go to the land I will show you. I will make you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great, and you will be a blessing. I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you. And through you all the peoples of the earth will be blessed." [Gen 12:1-3]

**10:4** And later, after Abraham separated from Lot, God said: "Look around you in every direction — north, south, east, and west. All this land that you see, I will give to you and your descendants forever. I will make your descendants as countless as the specks of dust on the earth; if anyone can count the dust, then your descendants can be counted too." [Gen 13:14-16]

**10:5** And again: "God led Abraham outside and said to him, 'Look up at the stars and try to count them — that's how many descendants you will have.' Abraham believed God, and God counted that as righteousness." [Gen 15:5-6]

**10:6** Because of his faith and his hospitality, God gave him a son in his old age. And when God tested him, Abraham in obedience offered that very son as a sacrifice on the mountain God designated. [Gen 21; 22]
